channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Tech stocks had a nice oversold bounce on Monday. Earnings this week will determine if it's for real
item.description: Investors are hopeful that last week's pullback was a clearing event for equities, but lingering concerns remain.

item.title: OpenAI bugging suspect Alfozan held without bail after Saudi government offers to pay
item.description: Saudi national Abdulrahman Alfozan is accused of planting a recording device in an executive conference room at OpenAI headquarters in San Francisco.

item.title: Trump says he'd meet with Putin and Xi, criticizes Zelenskyy
item.description: Tensions between Trump and Zelenskyy have steadily risen in recent weeks, while Russia, which invaded Ukraine, has received multiple breaks from the U.S.

item.title: Saudi Arabia postpones big investor conference to 2027 as Iran-backed Houthis escalate attacks on kingdom
item.description: Iran-backed Houthi militants have launched repeated volleys of missiles and drones at Saudi Arabia since a deadly airport attack earlier this month.

item.title: Apple announces product launch event for Oct. 28. Analysts expect touchscreen laptop
item.description: Apple sent invitations for an event next week, calling it "Pro and tell."

item.title: The turnaround of this beaten-up Dow stock looks for real, says Katie Stockton
item.description: Sherwin-Williams is reacting to oversold conditions following a corrective phase, showing renewed short-term momentum within its cyclical downtrend channel.

item.title: Anthropic is AI trade's last big hope for a major IPO this year
item.description: On Kalshi, Anthropic is seen as the last major IPO in 2026 after OpenAI delayed its public market debut. Others have postponed too.

item.title: Google says it can build data centers the right way. Some experts and residents are skeptical
item.description: Google says its Minnesota AI data center will add clean energy to the grid and protect ratepayers. Experts question whether grid upgrades are needed.

item.title: Elon Musk says he'll give a SpaceX share to every child in America next year
item.description: The SpaceX boss said Monday that he'll give one of his company shares to every child in the U.S. next year. He didn't say how the share giveaway would happen.

item.title: Gartner analyst behind tech rout: AI returns are not yet large enough to justify neocloud build-out
item.description: The firm stands behind analysis that sent shockwaves through the market last week.

item.title: French unrest compounds debt crisis fears. Paris-listed stocks, bonds and the euro fall
item.description: "It looks like either the bond markets riot, or the people riot, or both," one analyst told CNBC.

item.title: In pictures: More than 500,000 took to the streets as France protests erupted into violence
item.description: Over 500,000 people took part in protests in France over the weekend, which became marred by violence, amid demonstrations against rising living costs.

item.title: NYSE becomes latest exchange to extend options hours as appetite for around-the-clock trading grows
item.description: The New York Stock Exchange becomes second major exchange to announce extended-hours options trading for heavily traded ETFs and single stocks, following CBOE.

item.title: Wells Fargo's comeback is just getting started. Here's why I'm buying
item.description: Stephanie Link sees a buying opportunity in Wells Fargo as accelerating loan growth, improving profitability and the lifting of its asset cap fuel the bank's turnaround.

item.title: Women may be at greater risk of AI job losses. Telephone switch operators and PCs show why
item.description: The history of technological progress suggests that as AI spreads, the employment impact will hit women more than men.

item.title: Supreme Court won't review Trump's firing of labor board member
item.description: The court's action follows its June decision backing Trump's firing of Rebecca Slaughter, a Democratic Federal Trade Commission member.

item.title: Cornell sexual assault case has some prospective students rethinking plans, consultants say
item.description: Some prospective Cornell University students are rethinking applications amid the Jane Doe sexual assault lawsuit, college admissions consultants say.

item.title: Robot factories and hypersonic missiles: JPMorgan Chase's first $5 billion of defense investments
item.description: With $5 billion already deployed off its balance sheet, JPMorgan Chase is racing ahead on direct investments in defense tech, hardware and supply chains.

item.title: Putin reportedly proposes three-way summit with Trump and Xi on Ukraine war — without Zelenskyy
item.description: The report comes amid mounting tensions between Ukraine and the United States, its largest military backer.

item.title: Boomers are buying into the promise of monthly income from options ETFs, but there's a tax catch
item.description: Covered call ETFs have been widely adopted by baby boomers to meet monthly income needs, but unlike most ETFs, the tax implications can be significant.

item.title: Crushed tech stocks bounce — plus, new doctor survey keeps us positive on Lilly
item.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

item.title: 5 best veterinary practice loans for 2026
item.description: Compare veterinary practice financing options for startup costs, expansion, equipment and working capital, with picks for different borrowing needs.

item.title: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts expected to miss the rest of the season with blood clots: AP
item.description: Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts is expected to miss the rest of the season due to blood clots in his lungs, following blood clots in his calf.

item.title: Why hedge funds could be making a bond market shock more likely
item.description: The Bank of England's deputy governor has warned that hedge funds' activities could raise the risk of a global bond market shock.

item.title: Anthropic commits 5% of shares to new public benefit fund that could address AI job disruption
item.description: The Claude maker said that establishing the fund as an LLC will provide greater flexibility in how the money is used.

item.title: Bessent warns Zelenskyy to 'be very careful' about claims U.S. is throttling Starlink
item.description: Starlink, high-speed satellite internet provided by Elon Musk's SpaceX, is critical to Ukraine's defense.

item.title: Roth conversions: When the ‘juice isn't really worth the squeeze,’ according to a top-ranked advisor
item.description: If you're considering a year-end Roth conversion for 2026, there are some key things to know, experts say.

item.title: Always on, always listening: New AI devices are pushing legal limits and could put users in jeopardy
item.description: AI always-listening wearables from Apple, Amazon, Meta and other startups are getting creative with privacy rules and fueling concerns about covert recordings.

item.title: Software’s new consolidator gets big vote of confidence from Berkshire
item.description: Less than four months into life as a public company, Bending Spoons got a big vote of confidence this week from Berkshire Hathaway.

item.title: Investors are buying up vast tracts of timberland across U.S. in one of market's longest-term bets
item.description: Timberland managers buying for pension funds and other institutional investors can wait decades for returns, but the market can also be a profit trap.
